title: feat: implement stream api
body:
This update adds support for streaming task output (stdout and stderr) via a new StreamTaskOutput API.

Summary
- Introduced a TaskWriter component that buffers combined stdout/stderr output from each task.
- Each connected client maintains a read offset into the shared output buffer and receives data in real time.
- Streaming is designed to support multiple concurrent clients. A slow client will not block others.
- Added integration tests to validate stream behavior, including full task output, mixed stdout/stderr, and client-side cancellations.

Additional Changes
- Introduced a timeout around grpcServer.GracefulStop() to avoid indefinite blocking during shutdown, particularly when long-lived streaming RPCs are active.

- Updates to readme for running tests, building/running components

title: feat: CLI, protos, and gRPC server with unimplemented functions
body:
Main components of this pull request:
- CLI that utilizes a manager to make gRPC calls to the gRPC server
  - Utilizes mTLS and uses certificates based on the --user-id flag.
- Proto file with the generated pb files
- gRPC server that currently returns unimplemented for its features (start, stop, stream, and get-status)
  - gRPC server supports mTLS and TLS v1.3
  - It includes interceptors for the unary and stream RPC calls. The interceptor grabs the CN from the certificate and injects it into the context passed to the gRPC server functions. This CN will be used for authorization.
- Integration tests that call the gRPC server that test: 
  - Happy path tests for start, stop, stream, and get-status. These just check unimplemented for now
  - Context's that have been cancelled
  - Cert with no common name
  - Cert that is self signed with no CA
  - Cert that is weak (only uses a 512 bit key size)

title: Design document for taskman arbitrary linux process service
body:
Design document for the taskman service, gives high level design of the implementation of the L4 challenge: https://github.com/gravitational/careers/blob/main/challenges/systems/challenge-1.md#level-4.

The taskman service will include three major components
1. gRPC server
2. CLI to communicate with gRPC server
3. Reusable library to implement core functionality.
